A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PLaID++ study. The main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices 7.1–7.7 support reliable comparison, including matching retained material across figure renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original crystal-generation results, model ablations, and DFT validation of 1,000 generated structures in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds temperature-schedule comparisons and evaluations on additional space groups.

M1.justification: The Qwen-2.5 7B model, Wyckoff representation, tiered iterative DPO, joint conditional/unconditional training, and flagship temperature schedule remain unchanged. The new schedule experiments test variants of the existing procedure.

E1.justification: New Figures 9–10 extend conditional evaluation to eight additional space groups not directly optimized during RLIP. These groups are represented in supervised training, as their training counts show. This adds a transfer scenario within the retained MP-20 crystal-generation domain.

E2.justification: Table 1's seven literature comparators and comparator membership in the retained ablations are unchanged. The added space-group evaluations reuse Wyckoff Base and PLaID++; the temperature experiments vary settings of the existing method.

E3.justification: Figure 7 adds temperature increases of 0.1 and 0.2 per iteration alongside the existing 0.2-every-two-iterations schedule. Figure 10 adds standalone space-group accuracy reporting for the additional groups. Previously stated training, sampling, stability thresholds, and DFT settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The appendix adds targeted tests of temperature-ramp sensitivity and conditional transfer beyond groups directly optimized during RLIP. These extend the existing temperature and symmetry analyses; the representation, joint-training, preference-pair, novelty, and MLIP-validation analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for generation results. The new plots introduce no uncertainty estimates, and the existing regression and classification reporting remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 7 adds fast-schedule trajectories. Figures 9–10 newly report S.S.U.N. improvements over Wyckoff Base in six of eight additional groups and accuracy improvements in four of eight. For example, P3m1 S.S.U.N. is 10.2% versus 6.4%. Table 1's flagship stability of 22.27% and S.U.N. of 7.74%, and the DFT results, remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The DPO objective, metric equations, Algorithm 1, and Wyckoff mathematical background in Appendix 7.6 are unchanged. No new assumptions, derivations, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions, and discussion retain the same claims about symmetry-informed representation, diversity-aware RLIP, joint training, and generation performance. The additional experiments do not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: Figure 7 newly interprets slower temperature ramps as balancing exploration and exploitation. Figure 10 asserts accuracy improvements for most additional groups, although its values improve in only four of eight. The existing mechanism discussion and Section 6 limitations are otherwise unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 removes v2's first-page code-availability statement and repository link without replacement access information. Appendix 7.2's implementation and hardware details remain unchanged. This establishes reduced access documentation, not that the repository itself became unavailable.

R1.justification: v3 adds Liao et al. (2024), the EquiformerV2 paper, to the references and citations supporting the eqV2 model. The related-work discussion and broader research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Headers change from 'Under Review' to 'Preprint', and Appendix 7.2 receives small wording corrections, including removing 'significantly' from a performance statement. Section ordering and the main narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds appendix Figures 7, 9, and 10, enlarges plot text in Figure 3, and restyles Figure 4. Existing figures are relocated or renumbered, with earlier Figures 7–9 becoming Figures 8, 11, and 12. Tables and the overall visual organization are retained.

improvement.justification: The new schedule-sensitivity and space-group transfer tests modestly strengthen evidence for the design choices and applicability beyond directly optimized groups. These gains are tempered by limited documentation of the added group evaluations, removal of the code link, and Figure 10's unsupported description of accuracy gains in 'most' groups when only four of eight improve.
